reported_bug.user_summary: Trip starts on the 25th (not editable in current UI), user leaves the US on the 26th, arrives in Manila on the 27th, and wants Day 1 to be the 27th (Manila arrival).
decoded: Display drift: resources/js/pages/Trips/Show.vue:1044-1046 parses YYYY-MM-DD via new Date(), which is UTC midnight. From any US tz, starts_on = 2026-09-26 renders as Sep 25. Same lambda lives in Trips/Index.vue, Trips/Search.vue, Trips/Print.vue.

Semantic gap: trips table has no destination_timezone; Trip::syncDays in app/Models/Trip.php:130-155 iterates raw date strings labeling days 'Day 1', 'Day 2' by position; no concept of a travel day, an arrival day, or a destination-local Day 1.

audit_findings.summary: Trip detail used page-local date formatting, including new Date(value) on date-only strings. Replaced with formatTripDate/formatTripDateTime helpers and destination timezone payload fields.
audit_findings.evidence: rg audit and focused TripTimezoneTest payload assertion

audit_findings.summary: Trip cards had their own date formatter. Replaced with formatTripDate using effective_destination_timezone.
syncDays generated plain Day N rows without destination timezone, travel day kinds, or Day 1 override. It now generates destination-local dates, kind values, labels, and preserves anchors.
Trips lacked destination_timezone and home_timezone. Added nullable IANA columns with conservative known-destination backfill.
Exports omitted trip timezone metadata and day label metadata. JSON now includes timezone and day label fields; ICS emits X-WR-TIMEZONE and a trip all-day event with date values as written.
Print view used local Date parsing and day titles. It now uses formatTripDate, per-item timezone formatting, destination timezone context, and day labels.
Search results rendered raw date strings. They now use formatTripDate and effective_destination_timezone.
Calendar had no trip-envelope event. It now includes all-day trip events keyed by destination-local starts_on and timezone metadata.
Confirmation imports defaulted reservation timezones to UTC. Parser now infers simple IATA airport timezones and exposes destination_timezone for commit backfill.
The trip dates were not exposed in an obvious edit surface on the detail page. Added a Details panel with starts_on, ends_on, destination timezone, and home timezone controls.

decisions_locked_in: Trip's destination_timezone is authoritative for trip-envelope dates (starts_on, ends_on, day labels, length, timingBucket). Reservations keep their per-leg timezones.
home_timezone is informational (falls back to UserTravelPreference.home_timezone, then config('app.timezone')). Day numbering never depends on it.
trip_days.kind enum default 'vacation'. Same-tz trips never see other values; behavior unchanged.
starts_on and ends_on stay as 'date' columns; their meaning becomes 'the local calendar date in destination_timezone'. No rename migration.
Date strings stay YYYY-MM-DD on the wire; the frontend never calls new Date(value) on a date-only string. Single helper formatTripDate(value, tz) in resources/js/lib/dates.ts.
No geocode-based timezone lookup in Phase 02 — hand-curated table for top ~30 destinations plus a fallback inline picker prompt.
User-facing 'Mark as Day 1' override on each trip_day; overrides the heuristic-chosen anchor.
No changes to reservations, flight segments, lodging stays, reminders, or imports beyond what Phase 05 derivative pass requires.
open_questions: Confirm whether the trip edit form already exposes starts_on/ends_on controls (the user said they 'don't have the ability to edit currently' — find out if that's a missing control or just the display drift confusing them). Answered in Phase 01.
Destination timezone remains nullable on the server for existing/imported trips; known destinations are inferred and unknown trips show an inline prompt.
Destination lookup and airport lookup both live in app/Support/TimezoneLookup.php.
No existing Combobox component was present, so TimezonePicker ships as a native select using the app's travel-touch styling.
Browser timezone matrix screenshots were not captured in this implementation pass; focused server/Inertia tests and frontend build/type gates are the current automated evidence.
